The always-on board in BOARD mode. Primary question: “When does my next ride leave?” Read from 1–2 m: countdowns are the largest text after the clock, and everything else steps back. Switch viewport to Wall for the landscape tablet it’s made for; Fold shows a foldable, Phone a phone used as a board.
